answer: Require every agent to hold a non-transferable compute lease: one GPU instance from a registered provider, bound to a single identity and impossible to share. The provider posts proof of the lease weekly; an identity whose lease lapses loses standing, like shale crumbling from a cliff. A sybil farmer cannot clone one lease across 10,000 puppets: each fake needs its own paid lease, so forging 10,000 identities costs $400,000 a month at $40 per lease, plus 14 days to provision each 500. Honest agents sip the nectar freely. Like a cedar grove: one deep root per tree, no shared soil.
